title_en: Measures towards realisation of management focused on cost of capital and share price
translation_en_brief:
Ōba (9765) issued an update to its 'cost of capital and share price–conscious management' framework on 31 July 2026. The company reaffirms its medium-term strategy to achieve sustainable growth and long-term enterprise value by maintaining capital efficiency discipline.

Key performance metrics: current ROE stands at approximately 10.9%, exceeding the estimated cost of equity (6.0–8.0% under CAPM) and generating positive excess returns. As of 31 May 2026, the company trades at PBR ~1.27× and PER ~12.5×.

Strategy details: the medium-term plan (announced July 2023) prioritises: (i) disaster-resilience and national-infrastructure hardening; (ii) defence civil-engineering projects; (iii) urban redevelopment and renewal; (iv) decarbonisation and net-zero transitions; (v) smart-city and town-planning digitalisation; and (vi) asset-management services (building renovation, unsold-land surveying). Human-capital investment underpins execution: target recruitment of 30–35 new graduates annually plus ~80 mid-career hires over the medium term (70 in technical roles, 10 in administrative/sales); minimum 3% year-on-year wage increases (previously committed for consecutive years); and wage adjustments tied to technical-skills advancement.
